05 · Environmental

Environmental testing

Low radiological risk, drinking water, and environmental matrices.

Gross alpha and beta radioactivity; Tritium (H-3); Radon (Rn-222)

Radionuclides from the Uranium and Thorium series

Total Uranium and Thorium in environmental matrices

Soils, water, sediments, food, and vegetation

Brazil

Portaria GM/MS nº 888/2021 e CNEN NN 3.01

European Union

Directive 2013/51/Euratom

Technical differentiator: Cgcre accreditation for these tests, in accordance with ABNT NBR ISO/IEC 17025.
